item.title: Phase 2 & Phase 3 Overhaul: 17 New Tools, Hardware VRAM Guide, and SWE-bench Leaderboard
item.description:
Added 17 verified tools across agentic IDEs, parallel fleet runners, MCP servers, and open-weight models:

  • IDEs & Runners: Google Jules, Volt, Imagera Code, OMK, Carbon Forge, ccmanager, Claude Squad, cmux, MulmoTerminal, Sqwakie.
  • MCP & QA: call-me, Docsy, ReMCP, sqlite-graph-memory, agent-qa.
  • Models: Devstral Small 2 (24B), Qwen3-Coder Preview.
  • Guides Added: HARDWARE_GUIDE.md, AGENT_CONTEXT_TEMPLATES.md, BENCHMARKS.md, FAQ.md, RESEARCH_PAPERS.md.
  • Deprecations: Supermaven (acquired), Mentat (archived), Roo Code (archived).
